propositions: A new LLM criterion ac-process-gate must detect when an acceptance criterion merely restates a mechanical CI or rebar process gate (children-closed, tests pass, plan-review passes) that applies identically to every ticket.

The ac-process-gate criterion must accept (pass) acceptance criteria that name or depend on the ticket's specific deliverable — artifact, behavior, test, doc, or criterion — even when the deliverable is a test or criterion update itself.

The ac-process-gate criterion must be advisory-posture, 1-TURN, non-codebase-grounded, registered in CANONICAL_LLM, routed with scope [container, leaf] and facet ac-text-quality, with an accompanying rubric prompt and bounded-sanity eval corpus.

The rubric prompt must enumerate reject cases (children-closed, tests/CI/build/lint/plan-review/completion-verifier pass, merged/landed, commit-trailer/DCO) and accept cases (ticket-specific deliverable), and apply the litmus 'reads identically on arbitrary unrelated ticket' with anti-false-positive silence bias.

A deterministic unit test module must validate the ac-process-gate criterion registration, routing structure, front-matter contract, regenerated guide section, eval-spec shape, and effectiveness-recorder inclusion.

Live bounded-sanity evaluation must confirm recall=1.0 and false_accept=0.0 on the fire/no-fire corpus, with the result committed to docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/ac_process_gate_sanity.json.
